answer: Cross-Epoch Beacon Consistency Rule. Each identity must answer a rotating signed beacon challenge per epoch; its reply is scored against a rolling behavioural fingerprint (latency, ordering, response entropy). An orchard of historical responses is compared, and divergence beyond a threshold marks the identity dormant. Reinstatement requires re-earning reputation from zero across an oasis period of N clean epochs. Sybils therefore pay full re-warmup cost per clone, since coordinated new identities cannot inherit or fake accumulated consistency.
